JVNDB-2026-000135
Multiple vulnerabilities in QND
Overview
QND Standard/Premium provided by QualitySoft Corporation contains multiple vulnerabilities listed below:
Use of hard-coded cryptographic key (CWE-321) - CVE-2026-81326
Improper access control on a named pipe (CWE-782) - CVE-2026-84408
Taisei Ogura of MOTEX Inc. reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
QualitySoft Corporation
QND Premium Ver.11.1i and earlier
QND Standard Ver.11.1i and earlier
QND Advance Ver.11.0.9i and earlier
Impact
An attacker who can log in to a Windows PC where the affected product's client is installed may obtain an administrator's ID and password (CVE-2026-81326).
An attacker who can log in to a Windows PC where the affected product's client is installed may execute an arbitrary command with SYSTEM privileges (CVE-2026-84408).
Solution
[Update the software and Apply the patch]
Apply the patch after updating to Ver.11.0.9i or Ver.11.1i according to the information provided by the developer.
